description: Python package for UK open data: ONS boundaries, Nomis statistics, postcode lookups and deprivation indices for all four nations, joined on geography_code. Also analyses for charities, a command line and an MCP connector.
rules: Install with `uv add uk-open-data` and import `uk_open_data`. `kindtech` is the old name.
Statistics, postcode lookups, deprivation data and boundary properties (`geodata_to_properties`) share a `geography_code` column: join on it.
Loaders return the DataFrame library you have installed (polars if you have both), so install pandas or polars yourself. `load_geodata` returns GeoJSON.
Nomis tables can be split by age, sex and measure; pass filters such as `measures`, `gender` and `c_age` to `load_ons` to get one row per area.
The connector for chat assistants needs an extra: `uv add "uk-open-data[connector]"`, then `uk-open-data connector`.
